purpose: Route-local blinding, unblinding, analysis-lock, and protocol-deviation disclosure controls; no route promotion.

blinding_deviation_rows.blinding_deviation_class: route-local blinding / unblinding / deviation disclosure denominator
blinding_deviation_rows.blinding_or_deviation_object: Blind-analysis mask, unblinding log, signal-region protection, analysis-lock rule, protocol-deviation disclosure, exploratory/post-hoc flag, or metadata-only blinding object invoked by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
blinding_deviation_rows.blinding_integrity_test: Declare what was hidden, who was blinded, how analysis choices were frozen, when unblinding occurred, which sidebands/control regions were available, and whether deviations were disclosed before using blind-analysis language.
blinding_deviation_rows.deviation_disclosure_test: Declare every material deviation from the registered protocol, whether it was result-driven or validity-driven, how it changes severity, and whether the final claim is confirmatory, exploratory, or mixed.
blinding_deviation_rows.residual_gap: Blind analysis and deviation disclosure can reduce bias and improve interpretability, but they do not create evidence, guarantee severity, or identify a candidate without route-local records and negative controls.
blinding_deviation_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer unbiased prediction, independent confirmation, or candidate identity from blinding, unblinding, or deviation disclosure alone.

blinding_deviation_rows.blinding_or_deviation_object: Archive rebuild, lint, and release comparison; not a blind scientific analysis.
blinding_deviation_rows.blinding_integrity_test: A package can be rebuilt blindly with respect to nothing; archive freshness does not hide or unhide a physical signal region.
blinding_deviation_rows.deviation_disclosure_test: Archive changelog entries can disclose edits but cannot convert exploratory scientific analyses into confirmatory predictions.
blinding_deviation_rows.residual_gap: Clean release notes can coexist with no blinding, no physical analysis plan, and no candidate support.
blinding_deviation_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer blind analysis, unbiased public record, or route support from archive metadata.
